The '''''Shadow Dancer''''' was a [[Imperial Customs Corvette]] used as [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] vessel. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] sought to make his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] stealthy, using [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Baffle (component)/Legends|baffling]], a [[Sensor mask (starship technology)|sensor mask]], and a [[baffled drive]].<ref name="PP" />
